review.title: Account picker
review.note: Three ways to let you pick **which login a thread uses**. D shows what happens when a login runs dry, with any of them.

options.title: Auto account
options.note: Keep the account menu and add Auto.

options.title: One picker
options.note: Put the account choice inside the `model` picker. One menu, but a long one.

options.title: Account pools
options.note: Choose a pool of logins for each kind of work. **No picking per thread**: the runner moves to the next login in the pool when one runs dry.

options.title: Moving mid-thread
options.note: Reference: the same behaviour could go with any option.
